title: SAPD: Learning from Agent Experience without Environment Interaction
title_zh: 【SAPD: Learning from Agent Experience without Environment Interaction】SAPD：无需环境交互即可从智能体经验中学习

paragraphs.en: Scaling the training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically requires a large collection of executable environments, whose construction, maintenance, and operation constrain the expansion of training experience. Existing offline trajectories offer an opportunity to reuse interaction experience, yet effectively refining the current policy without revisiting these environments remains challenging: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can lead to catastrophic forgetting, while online reinforcement learning requires real-time interaction with the environment. To address this challenge, we propose S tep- A dvantage P olicy D istillation (SAPD), a method for learning from offline trajectories using relative step advantages. SAPD decomposes multi-turn trajectories into individual decision contexts for on-policy distillation, allowing the student to generate responses conditioned on recorded histories, and introduces relative step advantage signals to stabilize training. The entire process requires neither new environment observations nor additional multi-turn interactions. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA show that SAPD improves performance across different teacher configurations, mitigates catastrophic forgetting compared with SFT, and runs at least 4.7 × 4.7\times faster per training step than online OPD. We will release our code soon.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展大语言模型（LLM）智能体的训练通常需要大量可执行环境，而这类环境的构建、维护和运行限制了训练经验的扩展。 现有的离线轨迹提供了复用交互经验的机会，但在不重新访问这些环境的情况下有效改进当前策略仍然具有挑战性：监督微调（SFT）可能导致灾难性遗忘，而在线强化学习需要与环境进行实时交互。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出步级优势策略蒸馏（Step-Advantage Policy Distillation, SAPD），一种利用相对步级优势从离线轨迹中学习的方法。 SAPD 将多轮轨迹分解为单个决策上下文以进行在线策略蒸馏，使学生智能体能够基于记录的历史生成响应，并引入相对步级优势信号来稳定训练。 整个过程既不需要新的环境观测，也不需要额外的多轮交互。 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的问答任务上的实验表明，SAPD 在不同的教师配置下均能提升性能，与 SFT 相比缓解了灾难性遗忘，并且每个训练步的运行速度比在线 OPD 至少快 4.7 × 4.7\times 倍。 我们将尽快发布代码。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled LLM agents to tackle increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks. Scaling agent training across these long-horizon tasks typically requires diverse executable environments in which models can take actions and receive feedback ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Recent models such as DeepSeek-V3.2 and Qwen3-Coder-Next further highlight this trend through large-scale construction of executable environments for agent training ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . However, deploying, maintaining, and operating these environments introduces substantial infrastructure demands and engineering complexity, making agent training difficult to scale across heterogeneous tasks ( Liao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使基于大语言模型的智能体能够应对日益复杂的长时程任务。 在这些长时程任务上扩展智能体训练，通常需要多样化的可执行环境，模型可以在其中执行动作并获得反馈（Liao et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2026）。 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 等近期模型通过大规模构建用于智能体训练的可执行环境，进一步凸显了这一趋势（DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025；Cao et al., 2026）。 然而，部署、维护和运行这些环境会带来巨大的基础设施需求和工程复杂性，使得智能体训练难以在异构任务上扩展（Liao et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Existing offline trajectories offer an opportunity to reuse interaction experience, yet effectively refining the current policy without revisiting the original environments remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns from these trajectories by imitating expert actions. However, when trajectories span heterogeneous domains, their supervision signals may conflict, causing interference between domain-specific behaviors. Sequential SFT can further lead to catastrophic forgetting, with gains on new tasks coming at the expense of previously acquired capabilities ( Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . These challenges limit the use of SFT for continually expanding an agent’s task coverage. In contrast, online reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD) optimize trajectories generated by the current policy and can substantially mitigate forgetting compared with SFT ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . However, their application through online multi-turn rollouts requires continued environment interaction, retaining the associated deployment and execution costs ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . These limitations raise a central question: How can we continually improve an agent’s policy using offline interaction experience without revisiting the environment, while retaining previously acquired capabilities?

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose S tep- A dvantage P olicy D istillation (SAPD), which refines the student policy using offline prefixes and teacher supervision. SAPD consists of two components: offline trajectory decomposition and context-relative step-advantage optimization. Offline trajectory decomposition converts recorded multi-turn trajectories into decision contexts, each retaining the preceding interaction history and current observation as a fixed prefix. For each prefix, the student generates a group of single-turn responses, and a fixed teacher provides token-level supervision on the generated responses. This enables SAPD to reuse offline interaction histories while optimizing the student’s own decisions, without executing new actions or obtaining additional environment observations. However, offline prefix replay faces a two-sided mismatch: recorded histories may differ from those the student would encounter through its own interactions and may also be unfamiliar to the teacher. This mismatch can introduce context-dependent errors into teacher supervision, making updates based on absolute teacher–student discrepancies less reliable. To address this challenge, SAPD introduces context-relative step-advantage optimization , which aggregates token-level signals into action-level scores and compares candidate responses under the same decision context. Comparing responses under the same prefix yields relative advantages that provide decision-level guidance alongside token-level supervision. We incorporate these advantages into a joint objective to stabilize policy updates, alongside token-level OPD for efficiency and rule rewards for further stability. Experiments on three publicly available agentic benchmarks show that SAPD significantly improves performance across teacher configurations, substantially mitigates catastrophic forgetting compared with SFT, and runs at least 4.7 × 4.7\times faster per training step than online OPD in the measured configurations. In summary, our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出步级优势策略蒸馏（SAPD），利用离线前缀和教师监督来优化学生策略。 SAPD 包含两个组件：离线轨迹分解和上下文相对步级优势优化。 离线轨迹分解将记录的多轮轨迹转化为决策上下文，每个决策上下文都保留先前的交互历史和当前观测作为固定前缀。 对于每个前缀，学生生成一组单轮回复，并由固定的教师对这些生成的回复提供词元级监督。 这使 SAPD 能够复用离线交互历史，同时优化学生自身的决策，而无需执行新动作或获取额外的环境观测。 然而，离线前缀重放面临双向的不匹配问题：记录的历史可能与学生通过自身交互所遇到的历史不同，并且对教师来说也可能不熟悉。 这种不匹配会在教师监督中引入依赖于上下文的错误，使得基于教师与学生之间绝对差异的更新变得不太可靠。 为应对这一挑战，SAPD 引入了上下文相对步级优势优化，将词元级信号聚合为动作级分数，并在相同决策上下文下比较候选回复。 在相同前缀下比较回复可以得到相对优势，从而在词元级监督之外提供决策级指导。 我们将这些优势纳入一个联合目标以稳定策略更新，同时结合词元级 OPD 以提升效率，并结合规则奖励以进一步增强稳定性。 在三个公开的智能体基准上的实验表明，SAPD 在各种教师配置下都显著提升了性能，与 SFT 相比大幅缓解了灾难性遗忘，并且在所测配置中每个训练步的运行速度至少比在线 OPD 快 4.7 倍。 总而言之，我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents are increasingly trained on long-horizon tasks that require sustained interaction with external environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Supervised fine-tuning and behavior cloning enable learning from expert trajectories, but can suffer from gradient interference during joint training across heterogeneous tasks ( Yu et al., 2020 ) and catastrophic forgetting during sequential training ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . Reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO optimize policy-generated behavior using task feedback ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . However, these online methods rely on environment interaction throughout training. The deployment, maintenance, and operation of heterogeneous environments incur substantial engineering and resource costs, limiting the scalability of these methods across multiple environments ( Liao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体越来越多地在需要与外部环境持续交互的长时程任务上进行训练（Yao et al., 2023）。 监督微调和行为克隆能够从专家轨迹中学习，但在异构任务联合训练期间可能遭受梯度干扰（Yu et al., 2020），在顺序训练期间可能遭受灾难性遗忘（Luo et al., 2025）。 诸如 GRPO 之类的强化学习方法利用任务反馈来优化策略生成的行为（Shao et al., 2024），而在策略蒸馏（OPD）则在学生生成的回复上提供密集的教师监督（Agarwal et al., 2024；Gu et al., 2024；Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）。 然而，这些在线方法在整个训练过程中都依赖于与环境交互。 异构环境的部署、维护和运行会带来巨大的工程和资源成本，限制了这些方法在多个环境之间的可扩展性（Liao et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO optimize policy-generated behavior using task feedback ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 诸如 GRPO 之类的强化学习方法利用任务反馈来优化策略生成的行为（Shao et al., 2024），而在策略蒸馏（OPD）则在学生生成的回复上提供密集的教师监督（Agarwal et al., 2024；Gu et al., 2024；Lu & Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）。

sents.en: However, these online methods rely on environment interaction throughout training.
sents.zh: 然而，这些在线方法在整个训练过程中都依赖于与环境交互。

sents.en: The deployment, maintenance, and operation of heterogeneous environments incur substantial engineering and resource costs, limiting the scalability of these methods across multiple environments ( Liao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 异构环境的部署、维护和运行会带来巨大的工程和资源成本，限制了这些方法在多个环境之间的可扩展性（Liao et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: OPD derives supervision from teacher probabilities rather than environment rewards, potentially enabling environment-free training. Recent work has explored reducing rollout requirements of OPD through prefix-based learning ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Gui et al., 2026 ) . Reasoning-Prefix OPD shows that teacher-generated prefixes can guide subsequent student reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . BPO reuses prefixes to explore alternative actions, but still requires environment interaction to evaluate their rollouts ( He et al., 2026 ) . Prefix-GRPO replays teacher trajectories and optimizes student using task rewards from environment feedback, whereas ReOPD uses teacher supervision on student rollouts conditioned on the teacher’s prefixes without further environment interaction ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Liao et al., 2026 ) . In practice, these approaches rely on teacher-generated trajectories, whose collection requires deploying and maintaining the corresponding environments, which limits their ability to learn directly from arbitrary offline interaction trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: OPD 从教师概率而非环境奖励中获取监督，从而有望实现无需环境的训练。 近期工作探索了通过基于前缀的学习来降低 OPD 的 rollout 需求（Zhao 等，2026；Gui 等，2026）。 Reasoning-Prefix OPD 表明，教师生成的前缀可以引导学生后续的推理（Zhang 等，2026）。 BPO 复用前缀来探索替代动作，但仍需要环境交互来评估这些 rollout（He 等，2026）。 Prefix-GRPO 重放教师轨迹，并利用来自环境反馈的任务奖励来优化学生智能体，而 ReOPD 则在教师前缀的条件下对学生智能体的 rollout 使用教师监督，无需进一步的环境交互（Wang 等，2026a；Liao 等，2026）。 在实践中，这些方法依赖于教师生成的轨迹，而收集这类轨迹需要部署和维护相应的环境，这限制了它们直接从任意离线交互轨迹中学习的能力。

paragraphs.en: However, replaying prefixes from arbitrary offline trajectories faces a two-sided mismatch: recorded histories may differ from those the student would encounter through its own interactions and may also be unfamiliar to the teacher, which can substantially destabilize OPD training. Recent work has investigated OPD instability under prefix mismatch and explored ways to improve the reliability of teacher supervision ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . TA-OPD shows that some token-level teacher–student discrepancies are unreliable ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . ReNIO aggregates token signals into sample-level distillation weights, which can be too coarse for credit assignment in long-horizon tasks ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . Furthermore, SOD adjusts step-level distillation weights by comparing discrepancies across steps within the same trajectory, but these comparisons span different decision contexts and may therefore be unreliable ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . SAPD instead computes relative advantages from aggregated action-token signals under the same offline prefix, supporting more stable credit assignment.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，重放来自任意离线轨迹的前缀面临双重不匹配：记录的历史可能与智能体通过自身交互所遇到的历史不同，也可能对教师而言并不熟悉，这会严重破坏 OPD 训练的稳定性。 近期工作研究了前缀不匹配下的 OPD 不稳定性，并探索了提高教师监督可靠性的方法（Zhu et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026）。 TA-OPD 表明，某些 token 级的教师—智能体差异是不可靠的（Wang et al., 2026b）。 ReNIO 将 token 信号聚合为样本级蒸馏权重，这在长时程任务的信用分配中可能过于粗糙（Lin et al., 2026）。 此外，SOD 通过比较同一轨迹内不同步骤之间的差异来调整步骤级蒸馏权重，但这些比较跨越了不同的决策上下文，因此可能不可靠（Zhong et al., 2026）。 SAPD 则改为在相同离线前缀下从聚合的动作 token 信号中计算相对优势，从而支持更稳定的信用分配。

paragraphs.en: SAPD decouples policy refinement from the environment execution required by the online methods in Section 3 . As illustrated in Figure 1 , we first decompose recorded multi-turn trajectories into a pool of decision prefixes that retain the preceding actions and environment observations. For each prefix, the student generates a group of single-turn responses, which are scored by a fixed teacher without executing their actions. We combine token-level distillation with a step-level relative advantage computed by comparing aggregated teacher–student signals within the group. This provides decision-level supervision alongside fine-grained token feedback. Locally computable rewards, such as repetition penalties and format checks, further support stable training. Together, these components optimize the student’s responses using existing interaction histories, requiring neither new environment observations nor additional multi-turn rollouts during training.

paragraphs.en: Restricting the score to action tokens focuses the comparison on the decision and prevents reasoning length from directly contributing to the aggregate. This choice also limits length-dependent scoring error: as Equation 8 shows, a shared per-token bias leaves a residual proportional to differences in the number of scored tokens. Excluding reasoning tokens avoids an additional source of such variation from potentially long and variable reasoning traces. Reasoning still conditions the teacher and student probabilities and receives token-level supervision through Equation 5 . Action-length differences can still contribute residual error; the sum is not length normalized. A positive advantage indicates an above-group-average teacher-to-student log-likelihood ratio, rather than verified environment success.

paragraphs.en: In online multi-turn OPD, student-generated histories can be unfamiliar to the teacher, making its supervision unreliable; a large teacher–student gap can exacerbate this mismatch ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . With heterogeneous offline data, a recorded prefix can additionally be atypical under both policies. We therefore seek tolerance to context-dependent scoring errors, rather than assuming that every teacher likelihood is well calibrated on the offline pool.
paragraphs.zh: 在在线多轮 OPD 中，学生生成的历史可能对教师而言并不熟悉，这使得其监督变得不可靠；而过大的教师-学生差距会加剧这种不匹配（Liao et al., 2026）。 在异构离线数据下，记录的前缀还可能在两种策略下都显得非典型。 因此，我们寻求对依赖上下文的打分错误的容忍度，而不是假设每一条教师似然在离线数据池上都得到了良好的校准。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate SAPD on three widely used long-horizon agent tasks: ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA. ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) is a text-based environment in which agents follow instructions to complete household goals. It comprises six task categories: Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, and Pick2. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) is a simulated online shopping environment in which agents search a product catalog, navigate product pages, and select products and options that satisfy user-specified requirements. Search-based QA follows the setup of Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , requiring agents to interleave reasoning with search, gather relevant evidence, and produce a final answer. It includes three single-hop datasets, Natural Questions ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) , and PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) , and four multi-hop datasets, HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) , and Bamboogle ( Press et al., 2023 ) . Following the setup of SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate 128 episodes per evaluation round on each of ALFWorld and WebShop, and all 51,713 questions across the seven Search-based QA evaluation datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在三个广泛使用的长程智能体任务上评估 SAPD：ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的问答（Search-based QA）。 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等，2021）是一个文本环境，智能体在其中按照指令完成家务目标。 它包含六个任务类别：Pick、Look、Clean、Heat、Cool 和 Pick2。 WebShop（Yao 等，2022）是一个模拟在线购物环境，智能体在其中搜索商品目录、浏览商品页面，并选择满足用户指定要求的商品和选项。 基于搜索的问答遵循 Search-R1（Jin 等，2025）的设置，要求智能体将推理与搜索交替进行，收集相关证据并给出最终答案。 它包括三个单跳数据集：Natural Questions（Kwiatkowski 等，2019）、TriviaQA（Joshi 等，2017）和 PopQA（Mallen 等，2023），以及四个多跳数据集：HotpotQA（Yang 等，2018）、2WikiMultihopQA（Ho 等，2020）、MuSiQue（Trivedi 等，2022）和 Bamboogle（Press 等，2023）。 按照 SDAR（Lu 等，2026）的设置，我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 的每轮评估中各评估 128 个回合，并在七个基于搜索的问答评估数据集的全部 51,713 个问题上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. To evaluate the effectiveness of SAPD, we compare against the following three categories of baselines. (1) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) learns to imitate expert actions in fixed demonstration trajectories. As a fully off-policy baseline, SFT allows us to assess SAPD’s task performance and resistance to catastrophic forgetting under sequential task training. (2) Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) collects trajectories by having the student interact with the environment and updates the policy using advantages computed from relative rewards within each rollout group. Its reliance on extensive environment interaction provides a comparison for SAPD in both task performance and training efficiency. (3) On-Policy Distillation (OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) applies token-level teacher supervision to student-generated responses conditioned on offline SFT prefixes. OPD+Rule further incorporates rule-based rewards to stabilize training. Its objective differs from SAPD only by omitting our step-advantage policy distillation, isolating the contribution of action-level guidance.

paragraphs.en: Sequential training requires agents to learn new tasks while maintaining performance on earlier tasks. We investigate whether SAPD mitigates catastrophic forgetting relative to SFT by training both methods sequentially on WebShop, ALFWorld, and Search-based QA. In Table 3 , each row corresponds to a completed training stage. Diagonal entries show performance on the newly learned task, and entries below the diagonal track performance on earlier tasks. The two methods begin with similar WebShop success rates of 52.3% for SAPD and 51.6% for SFT, but their performance diverges during subsequent training. Following ALFWorld training, SAPD’s WebShop success rises to 57.0%, possibly because the shared output format supports generalization across tasks. In contrast, SFT’s WebShop success falls to 22.7%, indicating substantial forgetting of the previously learned task. By the end of Search training, SAPD still achieves 50.8% on WebShop and 90.5% on ALFWorld, whereas SFT reaches only 2.3% and 7.8%, respectively. This retention advantage accompanies comparable accuracy on the final Search task, which demonstrates that SAPD substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting without compromising its ability to learn new tasks.

paragraphs.en: Repeated environment interaction is a major source of overhead in online agent training, motivating an efficiency comparison between SAPD and online OPD. Figure 2 compares per-step training time, cumulative training time, and task performance. Compared with online OPD, SAPD achieves per-step speedups of 12.4 × 12.4\times on ALFWorld, 10.9 × 10.9\times on WebShop, and 4.7 × 4.7\times on Search-based QA. These gains also translate into cumulative training-time reductions by factors of approximately 12.0 12.0 , 4.8 4.8 , and 2.3 2.3 , respectively. SAPD achieves these savings with higher performance on ALFWorld and WebShop and slightly lower accuracy on Search-based QA. Furthermore, the observed speedup increases across benchmarks with longer interaction horizons, from Search-based QA with at most four steps to WebShop with 15 and ALFWorld with 50. Longer rollouts require online OPD to repeatedly generate responses and interact with the environment, with repetitive or unsuccessful actions potentially further extending these time costs. SAPD avoids this overhead by reusing offline trajectories, yielding greater efficiency gains on longer-horizon tasks.

paragraphs.en: We presented SAPD, a method for refining LLM agents from recorded interaction histories without further environment interaction. SAPD decomposes multi-turn trajectories into decision prefixes and compares student-generated responses under each shared prefix to construct relative step advantages, providing decision-level guidance alongside token-level distillation. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA show improved performance over OPD-based baselines across SFT and GRPO teacher configurations, reduced catastrophic forgetting relative to sequential SFT, and at least a 4.7 × 4.7\times reduction in per-step training time compared with online OPD under the evaluated configurations. These results demonstrate the potential of reusing recorded interaction experience to expand agent capabilities while reducing reliance on executable training environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SAPD，一种无需进一步与环境交互、从记录的交互历史中对大语言模型智能体进行精调的方法。 SAPD 将多轮轨迹分解为决策前缀，并比较学生模型在每个共享前缀下生成的回答以构建相对的步骤优势，从而在 token 级蒸馏之外提供决策级指导。 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的问答任务上的实验表明，在 SFT 与 GRPO 教师配置下，该方法均优于基于 OPD 的基线，相比顺序 SPT 减少了灾难性遗忘，并且在所评估的配置下，每步训练时间相比在线 OPD 至少降低了 4.7 × 4.7\times。 这些结果表明，复用记录的交互经验有望扩展智能体的能力，同时降低对可执行训练环境的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Three limitations are material. First, the common-offset assumption is at the aggregate action-score level. As Equation 8 shows, a shared token error b tok ​ ( h ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h) leaves the residual b tok ​ ( h ) ​ ( N i − N ¯ ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h)(N_{i}-\bar{N}) when action lengths vary. Thus, action-token summation does not automatically turn a shared token error into a shared sequence error. This provides an additional motivation for the action-only scoring mask: it excludes reasoning-length variation from the aggregate error. It does not guarantee lower error for every response group, since token biases and residuals can also differ between reasoning and action segments. The bound must still account for action-length variation; fixed-length or length-controlled comparisons can isolate it empirically.
paragraphs.zh: 有三个局限性是实质性的。 首先，共同偏移假设作用于聚合动作分数层面。 如公式 8 所示，当动作长度不同时，共享的词元误差 b tok ​ ( h ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h) 会留下残差 b tok ​ ( h ) ​ ( N i − N ¯ ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h)(N_{i}-\bar{N})。 因此，动作词元求和并不会自动把共享的词元误差转化为共享的序列误差。 这为仅动作评分掩码提供了额外的动机：它将推理长度变化排除在聚合误差之外。 它并不保证每个响应组的误差都更低，因为词元偏差和残差在推理段与动作段之间也可能不同。 该界仍须考虑动作长度的变化；固定长度或长度受控的比较可以在实证上将其分离出来。

sents.en: As Equation 8 shows, a shared token error b tok ​ ( h ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h) leaves the residual b tok ​ ( h ) ​ ( N i − N ¯ ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h)(N_{i}-\bar{N}) when action lengths vary.
sents.zh: 如公式 8 所示，当动作长度不同时，共享的词元误差 b tok ​ ( h ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h) 会留下残差 b tok ​ ( h ) ​ ( N i − N ¯ ) b_{\mathrm{tok}}(h)(N_{i}-\bar{N})。

sents.en: Thus, action-token summation does not automatically turn a shared token error into a shared sequence error.
sents.zh: 因此，动作词元求和并不会自动把共享的词元误差转化为共享的序列误差。

sents.en: This provides an additional motivation for the action-only scoring mask: it excludes reasoning-length variation from the aggregate error.
sents.zh: 这为仅动作评分掩码提供了额外的动机：它将推理长度变化排除在聚合误差之外。

sents.en: It does not guarantee lower error for every response group, since token biases and residuals can also differ between reasoning and action segments.
sents.zh: 它并不保证每个响应组的误差都更低，因为词元偏差和残差在推理段与动作段之间也可能不同。

sents.en: The bound must still account for action-length variation; fixed-length or length-controlled comparisons can isolate it empirically.
sents.zh: 该界仍须考虑动作长度的变化；固定长度或长度受控的比较可以在实证上将其分离出来。

paragraphs.en: Second, centering does not repair incorrect relative teacher preferences. For example, a teacher that reverses the ranking of two responses also reverses their centered advantages. Nor does centering alter q ℬ q_{\mathcal{B}} : histories absent from the offline pool remain unavailable, and familiarity to either policy is not guaranteed. Offline replay can introduce an additional mismatch relative to online OPD, but need not be more out of distribution for every dataset or teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，中心化并不能修复不正确的相对教师偏好。 例如，一个颠倒两个响应排序的教师，也会同时颠倒它们中心化后的优势值。 中心化也不会改变 q ℬ q_{\mathcal{B}} ：离线数据池中不存在的对话历史仍然不可用，且智能体对任一策略的熟悉程度也无法得到保证。 与在线 OPD 相比，离线回放会引入额外的不匹配，但对于每个数据集或教师而言，它未必更加偏离分布。

paragraphs.en: The analysis motivates testing three separate predictions: exact invariance of the step branch to injected groupwise score offsets; sensitivity to response-dependent perturbations and teacher ranking errors; and the effect of standard-deviation normalization under weak within-group score differences. paragraphs.en: To discourage malformed responses and repetitive actions, we use two locally computable rule checks. For format checking, we verify the required response tags and complete decision blocks: <action> blocks for ALFWorld and WebShop, and <search> or <answer> blocks for Search-based QA. Missing or incomplete required tags receive a negative format score. For repetition checking, we extract the generated action and assign a negative score if it exactly matches the immediately preceding action in the recorded prefix. Rule scores are aggregated and standardized within each prefix group following Equation 12 . The resulting advantages supervise all generated response tokens through Equation 13 , with λ rule = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{rule}}=0.1 following SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . All checks use generated text and recorded histories without additional environment interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 为减少格式错误的回复和重复动作，我们使用两个可本地计算、基于规则的检查。 在格式检查方面，我们验证必需的回复标签和完整的决策块：ALFWorld 和 WebShop 使用 <action> 块，基于搜索的问答使用 <search> 或 <answer> 块。 缺失或不完整的必需标签会得到负的格式分数。 在重复检查方面，我们提取生成的动作，如果它与记录前缀中紧邻的上一个动作完全相同，则赋予负分数。 规则分数按照公式 12 在每个前缀组内进行聚合和标准化。 由此得到的优势通过公式 13 监督所有生成的回复 token，其中 λ rule = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{rule}}=0.1 遵循 SDAR（Lu 等，2026）。 所有检查均使用生成的文本和记录的历史，无需额外的环境交互。

paragraphs.en: To understand how SAPD’s benefits develop over training, we compare its learning dynamics with OPD+Rule on ALFWorld and WebShop. Both methods train a Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct student using offline SFT prefixes and a frozen, SFT-trained Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct teacher. Figure 3 shows checkpoint evaluation results together with smoothed trends. On ALFWorld, SAPD improves more rapidly during training, while SAPD maintains a higher success-rate trend during later training on WebShop. These observations suggest that SAPD supports faster learning progress on ALFWorld and stronger sustained performance on WebShop, complementing the results in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解 SAPD 的收益如何在训练过程中逐步形成，我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上将其学习动态与 OPD+Rule 进行比较。 两种方法都使用离线 SFT 前缀和一个冻结的、经过 SFT 训练的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 教师来训练 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 学生模型。 图 3 展示了检查点评估结果以及平滑后的趋势。 在 ALFWorld 上，SAPD 在训练过程中提升更快，而在 WebShop 上，SAPD 在训练后期保持更高的成功率趋势。 这些观察表明，SAPD 在 ALFWorld 上支持更快的学习进展，并在 WebShop 上带来更强的持续性能，这与表 1 中的结果相互印证。

sents.en: These observations suggest that SAPD supports faster learning progress on ALFWorld and stronger sustained performance on WebShop, complementing the results in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments focus on reusing existing offline trajectories, avoiding the need to collect teacher-specific rollouts through environment interaction. As a complementary analysis, we follow ReOPD ( Liao et al., 2026 ) in reusing teacher-generated trajectories to construct decision prefixes, which are expected to better align with the teacher’s interaction distribution and reduce teacher–prefix mismatch. Although obtaining these trajectories requires environment interaction, subsequent student training remains environment-free. We compare SAPD and ReOPD on ALFWorld and WebShop using a 1.5B student and a GRPO-trained 3B teacher. As shown in Table 6 , SAPD achieves 76.6% on ALFWorld and 70.8% on WebShop, compared with 75.0% and 66.7% for ReOPD, yielding gains of 1.6 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These gains are smaller than those on SFT prefixes under the GRPO teacher in Table 1 . These results suggest that SAPD remains effective on teacher-generated prefixes and may offer larger gains under stronger teacher–prefix mismatch.

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments focus on 1.5B students; we further investigate whether step-level guidance remains beneficial for a larger student under teacher–prefix mismatch. We evaluate a Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct student on ALFWorld using a GRPO-trained Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct teacher and decision prefixes extracted from offline SFT trajectories. Figure 4 compares OPD+Rule with SAPD, which computes relative advantages among candidate actions sharing the same prefix. Within 300 training steps, SAPD achieves the performance of 78.6%, compared with 74.5% for OPD+Rule. These results show that SAPD improves the performance of a 3B student under prefix mismatch, supporting its effectiveness in this setting.

paragraphs.en: A generated response contains both reasoning text and an executable action, raising the question of whether step advantages should be computed from action tokens alone or from all response tokens. We compare these two scoring scopes using offline SFT trajectories under both SFT and GRPO teachers. Both variants apply policy updates to the complete response; only the tokens used to compute step scores differ. As shown in Table 7 , action-only scoring performs better on ALFWorld and WebShop under both teacher configurations. It improves ALFWorld success from 60.8% to 69.3% with the GRPO teacher and WebShop success from 50.0% to 59.4% with the SFT teacher. On Search-based QA, the differences are small. These results support action-focused scoring and suggest that excluding thinking tokens may provide more reliable step-level guidance when prefix mismatch makes teacher supervision less reliable.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的回复同时包含推理文本和可执行动作，这就引出了一个问题：步骤优势应该仅从动作 token 计算，还是从所有回复 token 计算。 我们在 SFT 和 GRPO 两种教师模型下，使用离线 SFT 轨迹对这两种打分范围进行比较。 两种变体都对完整回复应用策略更新；仅用于计算步骤得分的 token 有所不同。 如表 7 所示，仅动作打分在两种教师配置下于 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上均表现更好。 在 GRPO 教师下，它将 ALFWorld 成功率从 60.8% 提升至 69.3%；在 SFT 教师下，将 WebShop 成功率从 50.0% 提升至 59.4%。 在基于搜索的问答上，差异很小。 这些结果支持以动作为中心的打分方式，并表明当 teacher 前缀不匹配使教师监督的可靠性下降时，排除思考 token 可能提供更可靠的步骤级引导。
